visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium close-up of a young woman with long, dark hair, wearing a white lace top and pearl earrings. She stands against a plain, off-white wall in a brightly lit indoor environment. She smiles and gestures with her right hand, pointing upward while speaking to the camera. (2) A split-screen graphic appears, showing close-up views of her eyes. The top half is labeled with text about a soft clustered style, while the bottom half highlights a natural lengthening effect. She demonstrates the difference in eyelash textures and volume between the two styles. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of the woman's hand holding a grey mascara tube labeled 'ettusais'. She opens the tube to reveal a unique comb-style wand. She then uses the wand to apply the product to her upper eyelashes, moving it in a zig-zag motion to separate and coat each lash. (4) A comparison shot labeled 'After' and 'Before' shows the significant enhancement in lash thickness and definition on one side of her face. She smiles and blinks, showcasing the 'clump-free' results achieved with the specific applicator. (5) She introduces a second ettusais product, a lengthening base, and shows its wand, which contains visible black fibers. She applies this to her other eye, demonstrating how the fibers adhere to her natural lashes to extend their length significantly. (6) A dual-screen view compares the 'Clustered' effect on one eye with the 'Natural Lengthening' effect on the other. She points to each eye to highlight the distinct visual outcomes provided by the two different formulas and brush designs. (7) The woman holds two beige and black ornate mascara tubes from the brand 'Majolica Majorca'. She shows the curved brush wands in detail. She then applies the mascara by brushing directly upwards from the roots of her lashes without using a zig-zag motion. (8) On the back of her hand, she swatches a new black mascara formula to show the density of transparent and star-shaped fibers. She uses her left hand to apply this to her eye, demonstrating the ease of use even with the non-dominant hand. (9) The video concludes with the woman holding all four mascara products toward the camera. She provides a final comparison of the results, smiles warmly, and waves her hand in a 'bye-bye' gesture before the screen fades to white.

(2) As the speaker explains the problem of clumping lashes, the acoustic texture remains very clean with minimal environmental floor. The speech rate is moderate and conversational, with natural pauses that align with her narrative flow. (3) A faint mechanical 'pop' or click sound is heard, indicating the opening of a mascara tube. The voice continues with slightly higher pitch variability to express excitement while describing the product features and the comb-like applicator. (4) The BGM continues smoothly as the speaker details the application process. The vocal arousal remains neutral to positive, suggesting a helpful and informative tutorial atmosphere. The signal-to-noise ratio is high, with no distortion or interference. (5) During the second product demonstration, another subtle mechanical click occurs. The female voice maintains a steady pace, describing the addition of fibers to the lashes. The piano melody remains lo-fi and unobtrusive under the narration. (6) The video concludes with a friendly farewell; the speaker says 'Bye-bye' with a rising intonation and a cheerful valence. The BGM slowly fades out over the final few seconds, ending the audio track cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Introduction -> Solution Phase A (ettusais demonstration) -> Solution Phase B (Majolica Majorca demonstration) -> Comparison Summary -> Final Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a professional beauty tutorial and product recommendation guide. The creator aims to help viewers choose the right mascara based on their specific eyelash characteristics—specifically addressing the issue of 'clumping' versus 'straight' lashes. By demonstrating four different products from ettusais and Majolica Majorca, she illustrates how different brush heads and fiber formulas achieve distinct aesthetic results like 'clustered' or 'extended' looks.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently displays the packaging, mentions the brand names (ettusais and Majolica Majorca) multiple times, and provides a detailed demonstration of the products' effectiveness, typical of a sponsored or affiliate beauty review.
